endonym.gloss: a closed length of the count

description.value: Two and a half metres of twisted grazer-plate cord carrying one hundred and forty knots, nineteen reversed, with eleven dark glass beads inserted at spacings that carry as much meaning as the knots do. It was made at the warren mouth in the ordinary way, by adding to the working end as transfers happened, and was cut off and retired in 2287 when the section it recorded was fully closed. The cord is sound, the beads are chipped where the cord has been handled, and a forty-centimetre stretch near the middle has been rubbed almost smooth by repeated reading. It was given to the survey rather than sampled, on the stated understanding that a closed section is no longer a sentence.

notes.value: The accompanying document is a nine-page reading of the section dictated by the tally keeper over three sittings. It is the only translation of a cord anybody has, and it stops halfway down page seven for reasons that are not recorded.
